canonical_project: Tshwane Data Centres (three local facilities, solar upgrades)

location.subnational: Gauteng - City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality

notes: Local operator 'Tshwane Data Centres' runs three data centre facilities in the City of Tshwane area; installed ~312kWp solar (2023) plus a further 250kW SigenStor upgrade with Red Energy across the three sites. Small local facilities; no public MW capacity figures. C-grade.
